text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in 500s from customer-facing embeddings API (eu-west). Error rate 12% -> 40% over last 10m. Potential routing fallback observed.

ash-oncall: Acked. I’m jumping on this. Any quick context on recent pins/rollouts?

mike-sre: We rolled a model pin for release/2026-03-12 at 1729998888 -> maybe anchor change. Observed requests that should go to embeddings-quant-v2 are being routed to gen-chat-instruct-v1 fallback; schema mismatch causing downstream 500s.

sara-runtime: Confirmed. Router logs show "variant_incompatible: schema=embedding vs model=chat" for ~18k requests in eu-west in last 8m. Looks like fallback policy prefers lowest-latency compatible variant but pin anchored a different variant family.

lena-pm: This is customer-impacting for two paid accounts (analytics embeddings). How many requests failed vs succeeded?

ash-oncall: quick numbers from kibana: total requests 45k in window, 10.2k 5xx with reason=variant_schema_mismatch, 7.9k timed out on model conversion. Customers seeing degraded embeddings and higher latency.

ops-bridge: Creating bridge now — link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1738880000

ash-oncall: First mitigation I’m going to apply: set router override to prefer pinned_variant where compatible, and temporarily disable cross-variant fallback for embeddings namespace in eu-west. Commands in case someone needs to run manually:
```bash
infractl routing override set --scope region:eu-west --selector workload:embeddings --fallback-policy none --reason "emergency: variant mismatch" --expires 10m
adminctl pin rollback --model-anchor release/2026-03-12 --target previous
```

mike-sre: +1 run the override. I’ll monitor for retries and 500 rate. If that doesn’t cut it we’ll force-route embeddings traffic to a warm pool of embeddings-quant-v1 nodes.

sara-runtime: note: there is a stale anchor in the catalog index pointing release/2026-03-12 -> gen-chat-instruct-v1 (bad). Need catalog entry corrected after immediate mitigation.

ash-oncall: Running override now.

incident-bot: action: routing override set by ash-oncall at 1738880123 (expires 1738880723).

ash-oncall: Override applied. Observed immediate drop in variant_schema_mismatch 5xxs to ~2% within 40s. Still seeing elevated latency for in-flight requests though.

mike-sre: I’ve spawned a small pool of embeddings-quant-v1 in eu-west (scale +3). Pushing warm cache. Should reduce tail latency.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers: two accounts flagged with Incident ID INC-1738880000. Draft message queued to support team.

lena-pm: Good. Please include ETA and that we’ve applied an emergency route override and roll-backed the pin.

ash-oncall: Rolling back the pin now (adminctl pin rollback returned 0). Catalog corrected to point release/2026-03-11 -> embeddings-quant-v1.

mike-sre: Metric update: 5xxs down to 0.8% in last 3m, latency p95 for embeddings back to normal. Customer requests being served by correct variant.

ash-oncall: ops-bridge: can we keep the bridge open for 30m for follow-up?

ops-bridge: Bridge kept open until 1738882400.

incident-bot: Pager clear? Please react with :white_check_mark: when you consider incident stabilized.

ash-oncall: Marking stabilized but keeping oncall watch for 30m. :white_check_mark:

mike-sre: Root cause hypothesis: release/2026-03-12 pin introduced a model alias collision in the catalog service; alias resolution favored a chat/instruct-compatible build ID for the same logical name. Router fallback policy then tried to map embeddings requests to that alias when pinned variant unavailable -> incompatible outputs/5xx.

sara-runtime: Follow-ups: 1) add validation on pin operations to ensure variant-family compatibility for affected route types (embeddings vs generative). 2) add an automated canary for catalog alias changes. 3) add a short-circuit in fallback logic that checks schema compatibility before routing fallback.

lena-pm: I’ll own the post-incident action items and track in JIRA. Can we get a quick incident summary for customers and execs?

ash-oncall: Summary for execs: emergency routing override + pin rollback mitigated impact; root cause is alias collision during pin rollout. No data exfiltration. Two customers affected; we’ve contacted them and offered a rollback window.

mike-sre: Logging note: collecting a full trace bundle (router + catalog + model-serving logs) and uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1738880000/trace-bundle.tar.gz

support-bot: Customer messages sent at 1738880340. Waiting on replies.

ash-oncall: Closing notes: keep monitor dashboards open for 2 hours, ensure catalog entries have parity checks. I’ll write the blameless postmortem tomorrow and sync with PM/eng-run.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1738880000 transitioned to "stabilized" at 1738880543.

mike-sre: Thanks team. Short retro tomorrow 10:30am.

lena-pm: Thanks all.
